purpose: test whether the client Cbuf accepts devmap/map for a directly staged map
observed_result: The room screen remained unchanged after both commands. There was no Com Error, no Fatal error, no mmstart hit, and no map load.
interpretation: The Cbuf consumer accepts the text but these names are not registered client commands in this image. The only evidenced console entry used successfully is room.startgame, which is present in the command registration table. devmap and map must not be treated as available merely because their strings exist in map-list/config code.
cleanup: The run was terminated by the coordinator after the observation. tools/net_rollback.ps1 reported no guard/client processes, no CODOL WFP filters, a firewall baseline match, and working DNS/loopback/ports.
